claims.sourceText: Wikipedia article on George Knapp, opened only to read its underlying citation to a Simon and Schuster author profile, https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/George_Knapp_(television_journalist) , opened 2026-09-18
claims.text: Knapp's 1990 UFO reporting is said to have won a United Press International 'Individual Achievement by a Journalist' award. The underlying citation is a Simon and Schuster author profile which this board did not open, and the claim is carried at Tier 3 accordingly. The contemporaneous Review-Journal reference to an 'award winning series' in June 1990 is consistent with it but does not name the award.

edges.label: Knapp is credited with the Reid-Bigelow introduction
edges.note: Recorded separately because the Reid end of the introduction is what converted private interest into federal appropriation.

edges.label: Co-hosts the Weaponized podcast
edges.note: Pairs Knapp's four decades of sourcing with Corbell's leak pipeline.

edges.label: Worked with Bigelow's NIDS alongside Colm Kelleher
edges.note: Knapp's NIDS work with Kelleher produced the Skinwalker Ranch material that later carried into AAWSAP.

edges.label: Knapp introduced Harry Reid to Robert Bigelow
edges.note: The single most causally consequential act by any journalist in this domain: the introduction that produced NIDS, then AAWSAP and BAASS, and therefore the entire modern Pentagon lineage.

edges.label: Co-host
edges.note: The primary channel through which leaked Navy imagery has entered the public record.

b.label: Independent media as the disclosure substrate

edges.label: four decades of the record produced from a single local affiliate
edges.note: KLAS-TV is where George Knapp has anchored and reported since 1981, where the Bob Lazar interviews aired in 1989, and the institutional capacity in which he testified before the House Oversight Task Force on 9 September 2025. A local CBS affiliate in a desert market holding a national investigative record for forty years is a structural fact about the substrate, not a curiosity.
